title: Hazard and Flood Renewal Held from a HECM Modified Plan Designation
content:
Q. What insurance renewal is held in the line when a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) borrower designates part of the line for Modified plan payments?

A. Added to the amounts kept is the next insurance renewal. When Cedarline advanced a hazard or flood insurance premium on the loan (recorded among the borrower's Property Charge Advance Repayment advances) on a payment date after the same day of the month twelve calendar months before the handling date, it is the total of the hazard and flood insurance premiums advanced in that window. When none was advanced in that window but a set-aside on the loan (Set-Aside Accounts) is depleted with an annual hazard premium or annual flood premium above 0.00, it is those two annual premiums together. Otherwise nothing is held.

Q. Does an advance exactly twelve months before the handling date count?

A. No. With a handling date of 5 November, a premium paid on 5 November of the previous year is outside the window; one paid on 6 November of the previous year is inside it.

Q. Are hazard and flood combined?

A. Yes, in both branches: advances of either kind in the window are added together, and the two annual premiums of a depleted set-aside are taken together. Hypothetical: hazard 980.00 and flood 420.00 advanced in the window hold 1400.00; a depleted set-aside showing hazard 1000.00 and flood 0.00, with nothing advanced, holds 1000.00.
